english.title: Fail to surrender a revoked firearm certificate
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the holder of a firearm certificate which had been revoked under section 30A of the Firearms Act 1968, failed to comply with a notice given under section 30D(1) of the Act by the Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE AREA IN WHICH THE ACCUSED THEN RESIDED..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF NOTICE..) requiring you to surrender your certificate within twenty one days.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30D(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
holder of revoked firearm certificate
failed to surrender it within twenty one days

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 30D(5) for circumstances when this section does not apply.
(ii) The date of the offence is the twenty second day after the date of the notice; the offence is not a continuing offence.
(iii) See also the associated offence wording H1257 which relates to a shotgun certificate.
(iv) See offence wording H1258 where a firearm certificate is only partially revoked.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
48 months
